title: MeetingRepliedData
description: data of meeting.replied (ADR-0028). The addressed agent answered one turn. actor is that agent (the turn's to), target the convener. The reply is one model call over that agent's own records only (MR-06): the event's trace names the meeting or meeting_thinking role and profile, and credits what the call cost. The text is in the redacted raw archive (message_ref); a failed reply has none. units and artifacts are what the reply rests on, checked by code against the agent's own grounding set before the event is written; a proposal names what would change and nothing about how (MR-11). The web shows the speaker's cue only while this event's reply is on screen.

then.description: A failed reply produced no text: no archive record, nothing cited, nothing proposed.

else.description: Any other reply has an archive record. proposed_change carries its proposal and every other outcome none; answered and proposed_change cite at least one of the agent's own units (HR-1).
